title: Major scale
summary: Play a major scale up and down over one octave.
goal: Learn the intervals of a major scale and connect notes across strings.
body: First practice First frets and Steady pulse. The major-scale steps are tone, tone, semitone, tone, tone, tone, semitone. Play one quarter per click at 60 BPM. Learn bars 1–2 ascending and bars 3–4 descending; play the top once. Try 70 BPM after comfortable repeats.
